review_comments_data.body: thanks @sanjayradadiya  - but what does the 300px represent?  Is it the height of a particular element?
Not particular but mostly its total distance from document top to collapsible panel top

The fix works, but I like to try to avoid "magic numbers".  300px isn't the height of the red arrow in your diagram.

Could you research a little more why the value of 300 works please?

issues.title: Can't drag counters on touch screen
issues.body:
After the recent addition of a single toggle setting, it's now possible to pan/zoom the map on a touch screen.

But, it's still not possible to interact with the markers/counters.

Could you do some Leaflet research to see how to do this please?

Ideally, clicking on a counter will trigger it's popup, Red can drag their assets in Turn zero, and the little planning markers can be dragged to plan routes.
